title: Apply the configured Kafka shutdown policy to asynchronous listener results
summary: Reads the shutdown policy independently from the factory template and an actual container created from it.

change.description: Boot maps `spring.kafka.listener.await-async-results-on-stop` onto Spring Kafka container properties. When enabled, the listener container should allow unfinished asynchronous results to complete within its shutdown timeout.

notes: Both Boot revisions use the setup’s Spring Kafka 4.2.0-M2 substitution. The challenge runs its test kit’s genuine Kafka 4.3.1 KRaft broker on loopback and records a completed listener future and the container stop callback.
